metadata.observed_definition: All three saved ESS values finite; support_observed counts available side counts separately
metadata.missing_values: null / empty CSV cell; absent bank statistics remain NA, never replaced by zero
metadata.count_denominators: All 64 registered attempts retained, including projection/observation failures; counts report observed events
metadata.distribution_quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over finite saved query scalars; no eligibility filtering
metadata.bank_to_seed: Each statistic averaged equally across every registered bank in the group; incomplete bank sets yield null mean and separate available_mean
metadata.seed_to_summary: Mean and sample SD of the five within-seed equal-bank statistics; requires all five complete seed means
metadata.pooled_descriptive: Quantiles of all available correlated query records; no independence assumption, standard error or confidence interval
metadata.overlapping_groups: reference_all contains the same four linear and four MLP banks; groups are not disjoint replicates
metadata.distance_units: Frozen embedding coordinates; saved side distance/tangent medians and maxima, not graph-distance samples
metadata.locality: coverage_fraction_target_pool is the union of both frozen support sides divided by the entire 1084/1085 target input pool, excluding origin from support
metadata.B_scope: Previously observed development B; no setting selection or inferential independence claimed

publication_provenance.compact_scope: All six settings, main and LOO, source/linear/mlp/reference_all; across-seed and pooled scalar summaries only
